results.doctrine_read: FITNESS ASSEMBLY REFINED, not refuted: on >=1 root the route rides through strictly-discarded ancestors (archive retention load-bearing at gate level); on >=1 root all ancestors sat at gen train-max (ties) - the archive's uniform parent-cell sampling, not retention, is the load-bearing difference; champion-local keeps the incumbent on ties and never crosses between tied elites (comparator exp014 0/3 hard roots). The archive is load-bearing on every hard root, via retention where fitness is strict, via tie-band diversity where the desert ties.
